problem_type: First-party cover metadata excluded by redistribution license enum
symptom: 33 first-party Skills cannot declare cover metadata under the repository license
direct_cause: readSkillCuration admits a short redistribution license enum excluding AGPL-3.0-only
class_root: Supported curated licenses omit the application own distribution license
affected_population: All first-party Skills covered by root LICENSE and package.json license
internal_only_reason: The repository package.json and root LICENSE are the authority for first-party content; this extends the existing curation SPDX enum, without changing license terms.
invariants: The repository license remains intact when first-party Skills add cover metadata
generality_proof: Adding the declared SPDX license at the shared parser covers discovery and package validation without relabeling content.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Intake validates curation at the same parser

recurrence.reason: Every additional first-party skill cover reaches the same enum.
same_class_scan: 33 SKILL.md files have no license; root package.json declares AGPL-3.0-only
readSkillCuration used by discovery and package validation

prevention.invariant: Allow the actual repository license without dropping existing redistribution checks
prevention.failure_mode: Missing and unknown licenses still rejected for declared curation
prevention.strategy: Extend the shared SPDX enum with the repository license

legacy_paths.rationale: Extend the existing parser; no alternate parser or bypass

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing internal curation parser only; no third-party version or runtime change.

migration: Only metadata gains the existing project license; skill bodies unchanged.
residual_risks: Future bundled skills still require explicit curation and Workbench opt-in metadata; the completeness fixtures catch omissions.
